remarks: OFFERS ENCOURAGED, MOTIVATED SELLER'S MUST SETTLE ESTATE!  If you need a large house, this one is ready for you!! Impressive 5 bedrooms & 2.5 bathrooms, boasting 3374 square feet of versatile living space, this spacious home provides the perfect blend of classic style, comfort and functional living. Inside you'll find a completely refreshed interior featuring brand new paint throughout & pristine new carpets. The main level hosts a living room, kitchen, dining room, half bath and a cozy family room complete with a woodburning fireplace. Need flexibility? A dedicated 1st floor room off the foyer is perfect for a home office, den, playroom, craft studio or additional bedroom. Large eat-in kitchen with built in cooktop, oven, dishwasher & SS refrigerator. Adjacent to the family room you'll find a 3-season room to enjoy your morning coffee and evening cocktails plus a hot tub to soak your worries away!  Upstairs is the primary bedroom and dual entry full bath, plus 4 additional bedrooms and another dual entry full bath.  A full basement provides endless storage or future finishing potential. The exterior features are equally impressive.  Brick front, vinyl siding and a double wide concrete driveway that leads to an attached 2.5 car garage offering ample parking, automatic door opener and workspace.  The fully fenced yard serves as a secluded oasis and safety for kids & pets.  Roof-2019, 2 HWT's-2026 & 2011, Boiler-2002.  Perfectly situated for ultimate convenience, this home is within walking distance to the corner store and also the middle & high schools.  It's just a short drive to the public library and the sports fields and outdoor recreation at Veteran's Park.
